cfg.name: IN_Ex16_SMF_office_Mumbai
cfg.notes: IN_Ex16 9-storey office, perimeter steel SMRF (built-up box columns), Mumbai Zone III (Z 0.16), I 1.2, R 5, RSA scaled to V-bar_B; wind 10.2 gust factor (f1 < 1 Hz). IS 808 sections, IS 2062 E250 B0. Composite deck: bare-steel scope. EOR inputs: anchorage embedment (IS 456 outside corpus).

delegated_design.item: composite metal deck and concrete slab (deck profile, shear studs, slab reinforcement, diaphragm)
delegated_design.criteria: IS 875-2 Table 1 office 4.0 + partitions 1.0 kN/m2; dead 4.0 kN/m2; unshored construction stage (cfg['construction_stage']); diaphragm shear from the RSA / wind floor forces

delegated_design.item: facade cladding 0.5 kN/m2 and its fixings
delegated_design.criteria: IS 875-3 Table 5 local Cpe with Cpi; IS 800 Table 6 inter-storey drift h/300 compatibility

interface_forces.note: perimeter beams carry the cladding line load

delegated_design.item: anchor concrete breakout / pull-out and pedestal (pile-cap) design
delegated_design.criteria: foundation EOR: concrete cone / group breakout, side-face blowout and pull-out of the anchor groups, anchor reinforcement and pedestal / pile-cap design for the factored anchor tension and base shear of every load case (the bond lengths above are the minimum); IS 456:2000 with a recognised anchorage method (e.g. ACI 318 Ch. 17 / EN 1992-4) -- not covered by IS 800 / IS 456 in the corpus

interface_forces.bases: SFRS BOX500 bases: 24 M64 8.8 (6 per face), bond 2300 mm; gravity bases 4 M30, bond 600 mm
interface_forces.basis: calc_package connections[] column base demands (T_corner_anchor_N, V_N, P_N)
